name: 人像 · 窗边柔光
text: An East Asian woman with long dark hair sits by a window in the late afternoon, wearing a plain linen shirt, her gaze turned toward the light outside the frame. A half-empty ceramic cup rests on the table in front of her. Dust drifts in the low sunbeam that crosses the room.

name: 场景 · 雨后小巷
text: A narrow stone alley in an old town after rain, with wet cobblestones reflecting a single warm street lamp. Laundry lines cross overhead between the walls, and a cat sits on a step in the middle distance. The sky above the alley is deep blue.

name: 人像 · 夜市霓虹
text: A young woman stands at a night market stall, lit from below by a red neon sign and from the side by a green one. Steam rises from a food cart beside her. Her face is half in shadow, and the crowd behind her blurs into colored bokeh.

name: 静物 · 桌面质感
text: A weathered wooden table holds a chipped enamel mug, a folded cotton cloth, and three dried persimmons. Morning light rakes across the surface from the left, revealing the grain of the wood and a thin layer of dust.
